categories.name: Mandala Wall Hangings
categories.description: Intricately handcrafted sacred dot mandalas painted dot-by-dot with acrylics on premium MDF boards. Meditative focal points designed to infuse balance, serenity, and spiritual energy into living and sacred spaces.

categories.name: Lippan Wall Hangings
categories.description: Traditional Gujarati mud and mirror art (Lippan Kaam) modernized for contemporary home décor. Hand-kneaded clay reliefs embedded with gleaming geometric mirrors (abhla) that reflect radiant warmth and cultural heritage.

pages.title: About the Artist
pages.meta_description: Learn about the artisan journey behind Dot & Art studio creating sacred dot mandalas and Lippan mirror art.

content_json.title: The Artisanal Journey of Devotion & Precision
content_json.subtitle: Handcrafting sanctuaries of calm through sacred dot geometry and traditional Lippan mud art.
content_json.body: Dot & Art is founded on the belief that art should touch the soul and bring tranquil spiritual focus into living spaces. Every piece is born out of meditative practice, patience, and meticulous brushwork.

testimonials.content: The sacred mandala we ordered is an absolute masterpiece. The precision of the dots and the vibrant spiritual energy it radiates in our living room is breathtaking.
Stunning Lippan mirror art! The craftsmanship and packaging quality exceeded our expectations. It adds such warm traditional heritage to our modern entryway.

faqs.question: Are these artworks 100% handmade?
faqs.answer: Yes! Every single dot mandala and Lippan mud-mirror piece is meticulously handcrafted by skilled artisans dot-by-dot, with no machine printing whatsoever.

faqs.question: How are artworks shipped safely without transit damage?
faqs.answer: We use multi-layer bubble wrap, protective corner edge guards, and reinforced wooden or heavy corrugated crating to ensure 100% safe delivery worldwide.
